headline: SILVER CRATERS 14% IN ONE MONTH WHILE GOLD HOLDS — Gold/Silver Ratio Stretches to 75 as Industrial Premium Evaporates
snippet: Silver is hovering near $54 an ounce Wednesday, down 6.4% on the week and 13.8% over the past month while gold has shed just 2% — stretching the gold/silver ratio to roughly 75 and confirming the precious-versus-industrial split in the metals complex. Analysts tie silver's underperformance to weakening solar and industrial demand expectations, while gold maintains its safe-haven premium heading into Thursday's PCE inflation print.

headline: NEWMONT BEATS Q3 AND FALLS 4.6% ANYWAY — Why Record Profits Can't Stop the Sector Selling
snippet: Newmont reported record third-quarter earnings and still fell 4.6% on results day, while the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF shed 9.6% on the week despite gold holding near $4,000. The analysis frames the disconnect as tax-loss selling, momentum-fund deleveraging, and sector-wide multiple compression overriding even exceptional fundamentals — and argues the floor won't form until forced liquidation exhausts itself rather than when profits peak.

headline: AIRBORNE SURVEY MAPS MULTIPLE URANIUM TARGETS AT CHARLOT-NEELY LAKE — Historical Rock Chips Grade Up to 0.8% U3O8
snippet: Global Energy Metals Corp. (TSXV: GEMC) reported that a high-resolution airborne radiometric survey at Terra North Minerals' 163.7 km² Charlot-Neely Lake property in Saskatchewan defined multiple uranium-thorium anomalies, with the strongest concentration north of Neely Lake where historical outcrops grade up to 0.8% U3O8. GEMC holds a 0.5% NSR royalty over the portfolio, which sits on the eastern margin of the Athabasca Basin — the world's highest-grade uranium province.

headline: FIREFLY METALS HITS 22.5m AT 2.5% CuEq IN FIRST HOLE AT NEW DISCOVERY — Mount Joy Opens Third Target at Green Bay, Newfoundland
snippet: FireFly Metals (ASX/TSX: FFM) made a high-grade copper-gold discovery at its Mount Joy prospect within the Green Bay project in Newfoundland, with the first drill hole returning 22.5 metres grading 2.5% copper equivalent from surface. The result adds a third target to Green Bay alongside the flagship Ann Mason-style deposit and the Big Pond discovery, with the company describing the intercept as consistent with a high-sulphidation copper system.

headline: MACKAY GOLD CLOSES BIG BONANZA DEAL — Now Holds Largest Consolidated Landholding in History of the Comstock Lode
snippet: Mackay Gold & Silver Corp. (OTC: MKGSF) completed its acquisition of the Big Bonanza, the northern segment of Nevada's historic Comstock Lode, creating what management describes as the largest single land package ever assembled along the 6-kilometre district strike. The company, which closed on the Comstock Inc. southern assets in August, is now targeting 2-3 million ounces across the combined land position and says a drill program will be announced before year-end.

headline: IAMGOLD DRILLS 9.8m AT 11.02 g/t Au AT MONSTER LAKE — 47 Holes Advance Nelligan Complex Toward Q1 2027 Resource
snippet: IAMGOLD (TSX/NYSE: IMG) released results from 47 diamond drill holes totalling 20,641 metres at its Nelligan mining complex in Quebec, headlined by 9.8 metres at 11.02 g/t gold in hole ML-26-317 and 5.5 metres at 18.69 g/t gold in ML-26-320 at the Monster Lake target. Results also advance the Philibert deposit, and the company is guiding a maiden Nelligan resource estimate for Q1 2027.

headline: ASX GOLD INDEX JUMPS 3.3% AS METAL STABILIZES ABOVE $4,000 — Miners Bounce After Weeks of 30-40% Drawdowns
snippet: Australia's All Ords Gold index rallied 3.3% on Wednesday after spot gold recovered 1.1% overnight to trade above $4,055 an ounce, giving battered ASX miners a tentative reprieve from the sector's prolonged underperformance. Most major ASX gold producers remain 30-40% below their 2026 highs even with gold near all-time highs — and retail investors are watching whether the bounce has the technical footing to build.

headline: GALLOPER GOLD FINDS VISIBLE GOLD ON GLOVER ISLAND — Newfoundland's Last Major Under-Drilled Landmass Gets Its First Programme
snippet: Galloper Gold Corp. (CSE: BOOM) intersected visible gold in drillhole LPSE-26-02 at its Glover Island property in Newfoundland — the first structured drill programme on what management calls one of the few remaining large, under-drilled land positions in the Newfoundland gold belt. Eight holes totalling 1,332 metres have been completed; samples are at Eastern Analytical Laboratories with assay results pending.

headline: SPROTT: GOLD'S WORST MAY BE OVER — September Miners Fell Only 1.5x Gold, Far Milder Than Prior Liquidation Cycles
snippet: A Sprott Asset Management analyst argues gold's pullback is historically shallow: mining equities fell only 1.5 times the decline in gold prices through September, compared to the 3-5x multiple seen in previous forced-liquidation phases — suggesting a technical deleveraging rather than a fundamental re-rating. With Amundi flagging a recovery path toward US$4,500 and the Fed pivot thesis still intact, the analyst's base case is a sector rebound in Q4 2026 once tax-loss selling runs its course.

headline: AUSTRAL RESOURCES DRILLS 15m AT 4.59% COPPER IN QUEENSLAND — Waterhole Prospect Opens New High-Grade Zone at Cameron River
snippet: Austral Resources (ASX: AR1) returned a high-grade copper-gold intersection at the Waterhole prospect within its Cameron River project in Queensland: hole 26WHRC004 hit 15 metres at 4.59% copper and 1.16 g/t gold. Cameron River sits in the Mt Isa Province, one of Queensland's premier base metals corridors, and the result extends the pattern of high-grade copper hits at the project as the company advances toward a resource update.
